# Property Score

> Property Score scores UK property listings from Rightmove, Zoopla and OnTheMarket for HMO conversion and buy-to-let investors.

Property Score turns a listing URL into an investor-grade report in 15–40 seconds. Each report includes a financial model (estimated rent, gross yield, cash flow and ROI), HMO licensing and compliance checks, floor-plan reading, and area data (EPC, planning history, sold prices, crime, schools, transport and broadband). New accounts get 5 free listing analyses. Proposed HMO layouts use three analyses from the same balance. Subscriptions are billed through Stripe and can be cancelled at any time.

## Pages

- [Home](https://property-score.netlify.app/): Product overview, how it works, features, FAQ, and a form to paste a listing URL.
- [Pricing](https://property-score.netlify.app/pricing): Free plan, paid subscriptions, and analysis top-up packs.
- [Sign in](https://property-score.netlify.app/login): Sign in or create an account.

## Supported listings

- Rightmove property pages
- OnTheMarket property pages
- Zoopla for-sale detail pages

## FAQ

- Which listings can I analyse? Rightmove, OnTheMarket, and Zoopla property pages.
- Can I analyse a standard buy to let? Yes. Choose Buy to let before you start. HMO conversion is the default.
- Do I need an account to try it? You can paste a link first. Sign-in is requested just before the analysis runs.
- What does an analysis cost? Each listing uses one analysis. Proposed layouts use three from the same balance. New accounts start with 5 listing analyses.
- How long does a report take? Most analyses finish in 15–40 seconds.
- Can I share a report? Starter plans and above can export a completed analysis as a PDF.
